انسحقن (form VII)
# اِنْسَحَقْنَ (insaḥaqna) /in.sa.ħaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# اِنْسَحِقْنَ (insaḥiqna) /in.sa.ħiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
